run_curator_review: run a curator review pass that auto-transitions skill states and spawns an LLM agent to consolidate agent-created skills
maybe_run_curator: conditionally run a curator review pass if the agent is idle and the last run was longer than the configured interval
apply_automatic_transitions: apply automatic state transitions to agent-created skills marking unused skills as stale or archiving long-unused ones
set_paused: pause or resume the curator by setting the paused flag in the persistent curator state file
should_run_now: check whether the curator should run now based on the configured interval and pause state
